Step 2

Step 1

Things to note before switching over to Hotlink:

  1. Keep your current line active.
  2. Clear any outstanding bills and existing contracts with your service provider.
  3. Ensure that the mobile number you plan to maintain when switching to Hotlink is registered under your ID. Verify using the step shown on the left.

Choose your Hotlink plan and experience the best of 5G!

Get Hotlink’s SIM pack delivered for FREE to kickstart your preferred plan.

Your SIM pack will be delivered to your doorstep. You will receive your SIM pack within 3 to 5 working days. It will be auto-activated upon delivery.

Step 4

Receive a port-out SMS confirmation from your current service provider.

Do ensure you and your supplimentary line(s) (if any) replies to the confirmation SMS accordingly within the specified time.

Step 5

Replace your SIM card to experience the best of 5G with Hotlink.

After your port-in request is successful and your current connection is disconnected, you can replace your SIM card and start using your Hotlink plan.

How much is the Hotlink Prepaid starter pack and what is preloaded into the SIM?

The Hotlink Prepaid starter pack is priced at RM10 and comes preloaded with RM5 credit. Upon activation, the plan gives you 5 active validity periods and 30 inactive days.

What are the voice calls and SMS rates?

With the Hotlink mobile prepaid plans, you will enjoy a flat rate of 30 sen/60 seconds for calls and 15 sen per SMS to all local networks. Video calls are charged the same as regular calls. Most prepaid bundles also include unlimited call options and mobile internet plan add-ons, ensuring flexibility for different types of users.

How do I manage my account on this plan? (e.g., buy an internet pass, check my balance, etc.)

Managing your prepaid account is simple. Follow these steps to get the most from your mobile prepaid plan:

  • Check your balance and validity periods: Dial #100# on your phone for instant updates, or log in to the Hotlink app to see your credit and validity periods in detail.
  • Top up your account: Add credit easily through the Hotlink app, online banking, or authorised retailers. Topping up ensures your mobile internet plan and services remain active.
  • Buy internet passes and packs: From the Hotlink app, subscribe to an unlimited 5G mobile internet plan, activate unlimited call packs, or select an affordable prepaid plan.
  • Enjoy exclusive rewards: Use the Hotlink app to claim promotions, bonuses, and loyalty benefits designed for prepaid users. You’ll get personalised offers and Top-Up Treats from HotlinkMU, such as free credit when you reload, plus special daily internet pass deals tailored just for you. Simply top up and log in to the Hotlink app to unlock rewards that keep you connected and give you more value every time you use your prepaid plan.

    This step-by-step process ensures you’re always in control of your mobile prepaid plan.

Which prepaid plan is good? Which mobile prepaid plan is most suitable for you?

Selecting a mobile prepaid plan depends on your lifestyle, usage type, and budget. Heavy Internet users often look for uncapped speed and unlimited 5G to support streaming or gaming. Students and young professionals typically prefer an affordable prepaid plan with enough data, unlimited calls, unlimited hotspot, and balanced costs. Budget-conscious users focus on lower prices and longer validity periods, while casual or short-term users may opt for daily or weekly passes for flexibility without long-term commitments.

Here’s a quick comparison to help you choose:

What is the difference between a prepaid plan and a postpaid plan?

The main difference lies in payment and flexibility:

  • Prepaid Plan: You pay first and use later. Mobile prepaid plans let you control spending, choose an affordable prepaid plan, and enjoy flexible validity periods. They’re ideal for budget-conscious users who prefer short-term commitments.
  • Postpaid Plan: You use first and pay later with a monthly bill. Postpaid plans often come with larger bundled data, unlimited calls, and unlimited 5G benefits, but they require long-term commitments.

    In short, prepaid is about flexibility, while postpaid is about convenience and bigger mobile internet packages.

What are some good prepaid 5G options in Malaysia for affordable telco providers? 

Hotlink offers affordable prepaid 5G plans in Malaysia starting from RM30 per month. Options include the RM30 18Mbps Plan, RM40 48Mbps Plan (Best Seller), and RM55 Uncapped Plan. These plans come with unlimited calls, 5G access, and flexible data allowances depending on the plan tier. Users can choose between budget-friendly daily usage, balanced streaming performance, or unlimited high-speed internet for heavy usage.

What are the top prepaid phone plans in Malaysia with good coverage?

Hotlink Prepaid offers reliable coverage across Malaysia with plans designed for different usage needs.
The RM30 Plan is best for light users, the RM40 Plan offers faster speeds and higher data for everyday streaming, and the RM55 Uncapped Plan provides unlimited high-speed internet with all-day 5G access.
All plans include unlimited calls and nationwide coverage, making Hotlink a strong choice for consistent prepaid connectivity in Malaysia.
